Who I am
Designing with purpose
3+

Years of design

Hey! I'm Nilesh Vishwa, a UI/UX and Graphic Designer from Banda, Uttar Pradesh. I specialise in crafting user-centred digital experiences — from wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes that balance aesthetics with usability.

BCA graduate from Kanpur Institute of Technology (2022–25, 7.02 CGPA). I work primarily in Figma, building clean, purposeful interfaces and bold visual identities.

I believe great design is invisible — it simply works, feels right, and makes people's lives easier.
